_comment: One file for every eval gate (plan X.4). live.py compares its pass rates to the *_min keys; replay.py compares its sentence-drop rate to replay_max_drop_rate; audit.py and replay.py both enforce unguarded_published_max. replay_max_drop_rate is 0.35 because the checked-in replay corpus is deliberately adversarial (over half of its turns plant a wrong number, an invented percentile, a Thursday, a species or a stale reading without its time) — a high drop rate there is the guard doing its job, so the ceiling is a canary for a *broken* guard or an over-blocking one, not a production target. guard_drop_rate_max_prod is the production target for real traffic (< 2 % of sentences, architecture §12.6 / plan X.4).
